items.title: 68163_Tom Whaley oral history interview
items.q: And he and I chummed together and he said, what's the lesson today and I'd tell him.

ctx.x: Which in other parts of the world, black children weren't getting that kind of education so that means that this is why today that you are still a little bit ahead of the game, as far as culture and education is concerned.

My mother used to make us study and get our lessons. And when I'd get in school I could fool around because I had my -- and then high school, I became acquainted with the greatest football player in the world, Johnny Brinkley.
